best_for: Windows users who want a small, quick reader for PDFs, ebooks and comics, including on older or locked-down PCs where installing software is a hassle.

points.title: Reads more than PDF
points.text: Besides PDF it opens EPUB and MOBI ebooks, CBZ and CBR comics, DjVu, XPS, CHM help files and images.

points.title: No ads, no subscription
points.text: It is free and open source under GPL-3.0, with no ads, no bundled extras and nothing to pay for.

points.title: Runs from a USB stick
points.text: The portable zip needs no install and writes nothing to the registry. The installer can set it up for one user or for all users.

points.title: Every architecture, back to Windows 7
points.text: There are 64-bit and 32-bit builds for Windows 7 to 11, and an ARM64 build for Windows 10 and 11. People on XP or Vista are pointed to version 3.1.2.

points.title: Annotations, not a full editor
points.text: You can highlight, underline, strike out, draw, add text, stamps and shapes, and place a signature image, all saved into the PDF. The signature image is not a cryptographic signature, and the docs do not cover form filling.

points.title: Windows only here
points.text: This listing covers Windows, with 14 versions kept.
